novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a new mechanistic relationship in an LLM setting: after an explicit within-context correction, the model allegedly “retains a linearly-decodable residual belief in the retracted claim” that is separable from its stated belief, predicts later reliance, and causally drives that reliance. Searches using “LLM continued influence effect retraction misinformation,” “language model belief perseverance internal representations,” “in-context correction stale belief activation patching,” and “LLM knowledge-action gap steering” found adjacent work on human CIE, internal belief representations, and the internal/output gap—most closely “Language models cannot reliably distinguish belief from knowledge and fact” and the 2026 paper “Interpretability without actionability”—but no equivalent study connecting accepted same-context retraction, a latent stale item-state belief, and downstream inference causally. This is more than a direct transfer of human CIE because that specific latent-state-to-behavior relationship is new, although the linear probing, activation patching, and steering methods are standard rather than a new measurement paradigm, supporting high but not paradigm-level novelty.
